description: Developer-reviewed approval records for process-critical material properties. Empty on purpose: existing alloys.json densities, temperatures, shrinkage and burnout are not yet backed by reviewed sources.
review_policy: Add entries only after independent source review for exact grade, exact property and value, published document, revision, page/table, material/process conditions and documented reviewer. A GOST grade designation alone is insufficient; user-entered provenance cannot approve a calculation.
